_doc: Licence policy for devtools/licence_gate.py, from the owner ruling of 2026-11-08: only permissive licences (MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD, ISC, Zlib, PSF, Unlicense, CC0); MPL-2.0 allowed but flagged; no AGPL/GPL/LGPL in shipped services; no source-available licences (ELv2, BSL/BUSL, SSPL, ...); everything pinned with hashes and owned; licence notices kept. 'allowed' are the SPDX ids that pass with no review. 'family_variants' records why each id beyond the owner's words is in 'allowed' (each is a strictly more permissive member of a named family). 'flagged' ids pass ONLY through a reviewed devtools/licences/exceptions.json entry with status approved-flagged. Every other id (including permissive ones the ruling does not name, e.g. Unicode-3.0, MIT-CMU, CC-BY-4.0) needs an exceptions entry, and an entry with status pending-owner-decision is reported, never silently passed. 'forbidden_ids' are listed for the reader; the gate refuses anything not satisfiable from 'allowed' (+ an approved 'flagged' entry) whether listed here or not.

family_variants.MIT-0: MIT family: the MIT text without the attribution condition (cffi)
family_variants.0BSD: BSD family: zero-clause BSD, no conditions at all (tslib, numpy bundled code)
family_variants.Python-2.0: PSF family: SPDX id of the Python licence stack, of which PSF-2.0 is the current part
family_variants.LLVM-exception: a WITH exception that only adds permissions to Apache-2.0

owner_approvable._doc: CLOSED set of permissive, attribution-only licences the owner has reviewed (2026-11-08). An exceptions.json owner-approved entry can admit a licence id only if it is listed here (or in 'allowed'); adding an id is a policy change made with the owner, never an exceptions entry. Copyleft, source-available, non-commercial and proprietary licences can never be listed.
owner_approvable.CC-BY-4.0: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (caniuse-lite data; pypdfium2 docs) - attribution only
owner_approvable.Unicode-3.0: Unicode License v3 (unicode-ident data tables; ICU in pypdfium2's PDFium) - notice only
owner_approvable.CNRI-Python: CNRI part of the historical Python licence stack (regex) - notice only
owner_approvable.FTL: FreeType Project licence (PDFium in pypdfium2) - notice + credit in documentation
owner_approvable.IJG: Independent JPEG Group licence (libjpeg-turbo in PDFium) - notice + credit in documentation
owner_approvable.libpng-2.0: PNG Reference Library License v2 (libpng in PDFium) - notice only

forbidden_packages._doc: Python distributions that must not be installable on any real platform (linux/macOS/Windows, CPython 3.12-3.14) from any Python lock. In a uv.lock an override marker such as `sys_platform == 'never'` keeps them in the file; the gate follows the dependency graph from the project root and fails if any path with satisfiable markers reaches one.

components._doc: Every lockfile the gate finds must be listed here (an unlisted lockfile fails the gate, so a new ecosystem is reviewed before it ships). 'kind' selects the reader. The toy fixtures under fixtures/dlv/ are excluded by devtools/licence_lib.py (test inputs for the delivery engine; nothing in them ships).
